content:
FIX OWNER SESSION WITHOUT ASKING THE OWNER TO COPY TOKENS MANUALLY

1. Open the IVX owner login flow.
2. Sign in using the real owner account.
3. Read the Supabase session returned by:
   supabase.auth.getSession()
4. Extract:
   session.access_token
5. Do not display the token in chat or logs.
6. Send it securely to the authorized owner-session verification endpoint.
7. Verify the JWT with Supabase.
8. Confirm the authenticated user is the approved IVX owner.
9. Replace the expired IVX_OWNER_TOKEN_SESSION value securely.
10. Restart or refresh the worker session if required.
11. Run a live owner-approved QA-only job.
12. Return:
   - Owner session: VALID / INVALID
   - Owner authorization: PASS / FAIL
   - HTTP status
   - Job ID
   - Worker ID
   - Live commit SHA
   - Timestamp
13. Do not ask the owner to manually inspect browser developer tools.
14. Do not store an expiring user access token as a permanent Render secret.
15. Implement automatic secure session refresh using the owner login session or a server-side authorization flow.
